name: Middle School Math Endorsement, Undergraduate Certificate

MATH 1050.title: College Algebra
MATH 1050.prereqText: Within the past two years one of the following: MAT 1010 or MAT 1015 with a grade of C or better or appropriate math placement score.

MATH 1060.title: Trigonometry
MATH 1060.prereqText: Within the past two years: MATH 1050 or MATH 1055 with a grade of C or higher or appropriate math placement score.

MATH 1210.title: Calculus I
MATH 1210.prereqText: One of the following within the past two years: ( MATH 1050 or MATH 1055 ) and MATH 1060 , each with a grade of C or higher; OR MATH 1080 with a grade of C or higher; OR appropriate placement by math placement test.

MATH 2030.title: Calculus for Middle School Mathematics Teachers
MATH 2030.prereqText: MATH 1060 with a grade of C or higher

MATH 3030.title: Algebra for Secondary Mathematics Teaching
MATH 3030.prereqText: Math 1210 with a grade B- or higher and University Advanced Standing and Mathematics Department Adviser Approval

MATH 3050.title: Geometry for Middle School Mathematics Teaching
MATH 3050.prereqText: MATH 1210 with a grade of C or higher and University Advanced Standing

MATH 3060.title: Statistics and Probability for Middle School Mathematics Teaching
MATH 3060.prereqText: MATH 1210 with a grade of C or higher and University Advanced Standing

MATH 3090.title: Methods of Middle School Mathematics Teaching
MATH 3090.prereqText: MATH 1210 with a grade of C or higher and University Advanced Standing
